config.note: Statistical metrics above are from the 6-covariate AFT retrain (feature set reduced from 14 after diagnosing that the original model's crossing_days_log/building_loo covariates were weakly identified -- p>0.4 even for latest_voltage alone, given only 82 physical events -- and were driving overly conservative predicted mean_excess_rul for plateaued near-threshold batteries). These OOF metrics alone were still not sufficient evidence of planner-cost improvement (see docs/TASK1_IMPLEMENTATION.md Sec 5.2); the committed models/risk_forecaster.pkl additionally applies the physical-prior blend (Sec 4.5) at predict() time, which is a scoring-time change on top of this same fitted AFT model/calibrator and does not change any of the OOF numbers recorded here. See Sec 5.3 for the end-to-end integration-benchmark numbers that validated the blend.
